overlays.note:
shakeout 21 Jul (high, uptrend); 2 Oct upthrust - moderate significance in an uptrend with weakness in the background; Weakness 25
Context now: uptrend (rising 50-day, higher highs and higher lows, +10% in 20 bars); background: upthrust 24 Sep; price at new 20-bar highs; effort to rise 15 Jul on 1.5x volume, closed in the upper half - effort to rise with a result: professional money not selling (moderate significance); shakeout 21 Jul on 1.2x volume, closed on the high - shakeouts happen when the market has been bullish: weak holders flushed, at support / new lows (high significance); a test 14 Aug on volume 42% below average - (then: downtrend) a test after climactic strength: the background has changed (moderate significance); effort to rise 21 Aug on 1.8x volume, closed on the high - effort to rise out of the range (moderate significance); a test 4 Sep on volume 43% below average - a low-volume test with strength behind it: supply is drying up (moderate significance); a no-demand bar 30 Sep on volume 5% below average - no demand after a sign of weakness: professionals not buying, followed by an upthrust 2 Oct (Holmes p.81) (moderate significance); last 5 bars: down bars on heavier volume (1.5x vs 1.0x) = supply in control; latest: possible failed test (supply present) 1 Oct on 1.7x volume, closed in the upper half - but supply still present on the test (low significance); latest: upthrust 2 Oct on 1.1x volume, closed on the low - an upthrust after a serious sign of weakness: in the right place, at resistance / new highs (moderate significance); balance weakness 25/100.

rs.src: RS line = CYRX close ÷ SPY Massive (formerly Polygon.io) grouped-daily adjusted bars, RS cache feeds/rs/cache/grouped close on the same date (same data source as the chart bars; dates without a SPY close are skipped, never interpolated); shown in the bar tooltip. Blue dot under a price bar = RS line above its prior 251 bars (52-week RS-line high) while the close is NOT at a 252-bar closing high (RS leads price); RS-line highs together with price are listed in the tooltip only. Dots need 252 bars of RS history: judged from 2025-10-06.

rating.label: IBD-style RS (our calc, not IBD's official rating)
rating.src: feeds/rs/latest.json (research-tools/rs_rank.py: raw = 2·ROC63 + ROC126 + ROC189 + ROC252, percentile 1-99; rank 1 = strongest)

hist.rule: STRONG (bright green): rating >= 70 and d >= +3 · FIRM (dark green): rating >= 70 and -3 < d < +3 · WEAK (dark red): rating < 50 or d <= -10 · NEUTRAL (olive): everything else (rating 50-69, or 3-10 below its MA). A band switches only after the new state holds 2 sessions in a row; no band before the MA21 exists.
hist.src: RS rating history: feeds/rs/rating_history.json (research-tools/rs_rank.py; each session ranked from the Massive grouped-daily cache using only bars up to that session; only sessions with a full 252-session lookback). History for CYRX starts 2025-10-07 and ends 2026-10-02; nothing is drawn before it. Orange line = 21-session simple moving average of the rating (needs 21 consecutive rated sessions).
